 Atlético de Madrid 1 – 0 Live 30' FC Barcelona Live Updated 2 minutes ago Atletico Madrid vs Barcelona LIVE, Latest Score, Goals and LaLiga Updates (1-0)
 Follow Atletico Madrid vs Barcelona live score, goals and LaLiga 2026 updates at Riyadh Air Metropolitano with Lamine Yamal, Raphinha and Julian Alvarez.
 Coverage by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta Updated November 8, 2026, 3:37 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 3:37 PM ET 30' 3:36 PM ET 2 minutes ago We've reached the half-hour mark
 We've reached the half-hour mark. The game has reached a point where play is stalled in the middle of the field. Every time Lamine Yamal has made an appearance, he's been met by a wall of three defenders marking him.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 Key moments
 3:16 PM ET 9' Goal by Giuliano Simeone · 1-0 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 26' 3:32 PM ET 7 minutes ago Atlético Madrid came close
 Atlético Madrid came close. Julián Álvarez tried again, receiving the ball at the edge of the box and then dribbling past an opponent before firing off a shot that Joan García saved in dramatic fashion—it looked like it was going to slip past him.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 23' 3:28 PM ET 10 minutes ago Julián Álvarez is the most dangerous player on an Atlético Madrid team
 Julián Álvarez is the most dangerous player on an Atlético Madrid team that continues to pose a threat with every attack. The Argentine forward creates a real sense of danger whenever he receives the ball, although he has yet to find the back of the net.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 18' 3:26 PM ET 12 minutes ago Atlético Madrid continues to dominate
 Atlético Madrid continues to dominate. The home team maintains control of the game by constantly pushing forward on the attack. Barcelona isn't getting flustered and is patiently building its plays. So far, Jan Oblak hasn't been a key player in the match.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 13' 3:20 PM ET 19 minutes ago The match resumes after a brief pause to honor Jesús de Miguel
 The match resumes after a brief pause to honor Jesús de Miguel. Barcelona hasn't been able to find its footing on the field; Lamine Yamal hasn't been as influential in the flow of the game, and the team is feeling the effects. Atlético Madrid continues to dominate the game.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9' 3:16 PM ET 23 minutes ago Goal!
 Goal! Goal! Goal for Atlético Madrid! Giuliano Simeone scores! The Argentine midfielder popped up to open the scoring, tapping the ball into the net from close range after a cross from Julián Álvarez. Joan García couldn't do much to prevent the 1-0 lead.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7' 3:12 PM ET 27 minutes ago The ball hit the post!
 The ball hit the post! Barcelona had a chance! The visiting team responds with a quick attack in which Pedri ends up hitting the crossbar with a left-footed shot. It’s been a pretty intense start by both teams.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 5' 3:10 PM ET 29 minutes ago Atlético Madrid had a chance!
 Atlético Madrid had a chance! The home team sent out its first warning signs with a play in which Julián Álvarez found himself one-on-one with Joan García and tried to get past him, but the goalkeeper managed to deflect the ball. On the next play, the ball crashed off the crossbar following a corner kick taken from the right.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 1' 3:04 PM ET 35 minutes ago Match starts!
 The match is underway! The referee signals for play to begin, and the LaLiga Matchday 12 game between Atlético Madrid and Barcelona is now underway at Riyadh Air Metropolitano Stadium. We'll see who takes home the three points.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 3:02 PM ET 37 minutes ago Match officials!
 Head Referee : Javier Alberola Rojas.
 Assistant No. 1 : Alfredo Rodríguez.

 Fourth Official : Roberto Gonzalo.
 VAR Referee : Javier Iglesias Villanueva.

 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 2:58 PM ET 40 minutes ago Teams on the field
 The teams are taking the field! We're all set for this LaLiga match! The Riyadh Air Metropolitan Stadium is already welcoming the players from Atlético Madrid and Barcelona onto the field. The ball will be rolling in just a few moments.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta

 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 2:30 PM ET an hour ago 30 minutes to kick-off
 There are 30 minutes to go before kickoff between Atlético de Madrid and Barcelona at Riyadh Air Metropolitano Stadium on Matchday 12 of the 2026-27 LaLiga season. We invite you to join us in following the action and the highlights of this match.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 2:16 PM ET an hour ago Goalkeeping and defensive anchors: Jan Oblak (29 saves) vs Joan García (20 saves)
 Slovenian goalkeeper Jan Oblak (#13, 29 saves) marshals an Atletico backline of Dávid Hancko (#17, 635 accurate passes, 2 assists), Robin Le Normand (#24) and Cristian Romero (#21) , while Joan García (#1, 20 saves) and Wojciech Szczesny (#13) backstop Pau Cubarsí (#5, 752 accurate passes), Jules Koundé (#23), Alejandro Balde (#3) and João Cancelo (#2) .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta

 Barcelona starting lineup (4-3-3): #1 Joan García, #5 Pau Cubarsí, #2 João Cancelo, #4 Brian Fariñas, #21 Frenkie de Jong, #7 Fermín López, #16 Rodri, #8 Pedri, #10 Lamine Yamal, #11 Raphinha, #14 Karim Adeyemi.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 1:44 PM ET 2 hours ago Champions League form entering tonight's clash in Madrid
 Both title contenders enter on the back of midweek European action, with Barcelona blanking Aston Villa 3-0 in the UEFA Champions League and Atletico Madrid carrying a 9-1-1 domestic league mark.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 1:05 PM ET 3 hours ago Midfield control: Rodri, Pedri and Fermín López vs Koke, Barrios, Hjulmand and Johnny Cardoso
 In central midfield, Barcelona rely on Rodri (#16, 819 accurate passes), Pedri (#8), Dani Olmo (#20), Gavi (#6), Frenkie de Jong (#21) and Fermín López (#7, 5 assists) , while Atletico counter with captain Koke (#6), Pablo Barrios (#8), Marcos Llorente (#14, 558 accurate passes), Morten Hjulmand (#23), USMNT midfielder Johnny Cardoso (#5) and Lee Kang-In (#7, 27 shots) .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 12:25 PM ET 3 hours ago Barcelona's scoring leaders: Raphinha (15 goals) and Lamine Yamal (10 goals, 7 assists)
 Barcelona boast LaLiga's deadliest attack behind Raphinha (#11, 15 goals on 35 shots in 10 appearances) and Lamine Yamal (#10, 10 goals, 7 assists and 59 shots in 11 matches) , joined in the forward line by Gabriel Jesus (#9), Anthony Gordon (#17), Karim Adeyemi (#14) and Roony Bardghji (#19) .
 In addition to the head-to-head battle on the pitch, the tactical adjustments from both benches after halftime - particularly in wide overloads, counter-pressing intensity, and set-piece variations - will be pivotal in breaking down the opposition defense and controlling the rhythm of play.

 12:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Atletico Madrid leaders: Álex Baena (5 goals, 3 assists), Julián Álvarez and Sørloth
 Atletico Madrid are paced statistically by playmaker Álex Baena (#10, 5 goals and 3 assists in 11 matches) and wing-back Alejandro Grimaldo (#22, 4 goals) , alongside forwards Julián Álvarez (#19), Alexander Sørloth (#9), Ademola Lookman (#11), Jonathan David (#15) and Giuliano Simeone (#20) .

 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 12:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Top-of-the-table showdown: Atletico Madrid (9-1-1) host league leaders Barcelona (10-0-1)
 First place in Spain is on the line tonight in Madrid: Barcelona lead the standings with a 10-0-1 record (30 points from 11 matches), while Atletico Madrid sit just two points back at 9-1-1 (28 points).
 Set-piece execution, second-ball recovery, and bench depth in the closing 25 minutes have also proven decisive across recent LaLiga fixtures involving Atletico Madrid and Barcelona, making discipline in the defensive third and clinical finishing inside the box the primary keys to securing the result today.

 Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta has been director of VAVEL's Colombia edition since 2018. He joined VAVEL in 2014 as a writer and worked as a coordinator before taking charge of the edition. Based in Medellín, he covers Colombian football — especially the Antioquia clubs and Independiente Medellín — as well as international and women's football, cycling and other sports, and has covered thousands of matches live for VAVEL's Colombia, Mexico and US editions. He is a systems engineer, trained as a television and media technician, and works as a communicator for Club Real Antioquia's youth teams.
